snippet.title: Introducing the Digital Amp
snippet.description:
Explore your sound with effects & pedals. Jam to backing tracks, or use in lessons and songs. No cables needed. Only wired headphones. An accessible amplifier for both acoustic and electric guitar. The amp features 3 acoustic mic presets, 4 electric amp presets and 6 effects pedals. The ultimate starting amplifier for beginners, and a perfect amp on the go for intermediates and pros.

Available on iOS only.
